name: Craig Jones Riding Control System
description: Craig Jones’s Power Ride covers leg rides, upper-body controls, turtle breakdowns and submission transitions from several top positions.
summary: A top-control course built around leg rides, upper-body controls and turtle riding, with entries and submission follow-ups.
overview:
Power Ride: A New Philosophy on Pinning by Craig Jones approaches top control through leg rides and upper-body controls, with a dedicated section on turtle riding.

The six-volume series covers entries from pins and passing positions, then submission follow-ups. It suits grapplers who want to hold and attack an opponent across several top positions, including when the opponent turns toward turtle.

guide.display_title: Craig Jones: Riding Control with Power Ride

fits: You can get on top but struggle to keep an opponent down as they turn or build toward turtle.
You want wrestling-style rides alongside upper-body pinning and submission options.

includes: Leg splitting, rides, turks, shelves and rear-mount control.
Crossfaces, claws, handcuffs and half nelsons, plus turtle rides and cradles.
Entries from pins and passes, followed by arm-triangle, darce, kimura and other submission topics.
limits: Control across several rides and pins takes priority over a complete guard-passing curriculum or a mount-only treatment.
